name: Chrome DevTools
summary: Drive and inspect a live Chrome browser from the agent: traces, performance profiles, console logs, and network requests.
description: Google's Chrome DevTools MCP server, spawned locally via npx (chrome-devtools-mcp@1.13.0). Gives coding agents the full DevTools surface over MCP: navigate, inspect, profile performance and read console/network. Runs a real browser locally, so the client asks for explicit confirmation before installing a stdio server.
author: Google
